caption:
Gratitude is a gift you give yourself.

Allah gave Luqman wisdom, and with it the instruction to be grateful to Allah. “Whoever is grateful, it is only for his own good; and whoever is ungrateful, then Allah is Self-Sufficient, Praiseworthy.”

Surah Luqman 31:12

Name one thing you're grateful for today in the comments.

#quran #gratitude #shukr #alhamdulillah #luqman
alt_text: Indeed, We endowed Luqmān with wisdom, [saying], “Be grateful to Allah.” Whoever is grateful, it is only for his own good; and whoever is ungrateful, then Allah is Self-Sufficient, Praiseworthy (Surah Luqman 31:12)
